_help: Copy this file, change the values, run it. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Find ids with: Simulator.py --list-courses tokyo   and   Simulator.py --find-skill "corner accel"
_course: 10606 = Tokyo 2400m turf. Use --list-courses <text> to find your race.

A._note: Your current build. Stats = the five numbers on the trainee's status screen (before the race).
A._aptitudes: Letters S A B C D E F G for the race's distance, turf/dirt, and your running style
A._skills: Every skill the trainee has, by exact English name or id (unique and inherited skills too)

B._note: An alternative to compare. Delete this whole block if you only want one build.
